name: @map-harness/spatial-connect
description: External data connectors at connection capability: the versioned spatial-connect@1 contract with PostGIS, S3-compatible object-store, and COG connection specs, protocol-level connectivity and authentication verification (PG v3 wire handshake with SCRAM-SHA-256/MD5/cleartext, SigV4-signed zero-key ListObjectsV2, HTTP-range TIFF/BigTIFF header validation), validated deployment Config with credential references, keyless fixture contract lanes, and a key-activated re-verification lane
